Which statement about gases is correct?
A
Gases are difficult to compress when pressure is applied.
B
The particles in gases are close together.
C
The particles in gases have a random arrangement.
D
The particles in gases move slowly past each other.

options.label: A
options.text: Gases are difficult to compress when pressure is applied.

options.label: B
options.text: The particles in gases are close together.

options.label: C
options.text: The particles in gases have a random arrangement.

options.label: D
options.text: The particles in gases move slowly past each other.
